## About
Dr. Joe Gutierrez earned his Doctor of Chiropractic degree from Parker College of Chiropractic in Dallas. After practicing in Dallas, Denton and Little Elm, he decided to make Frisco his chiropractic home. His approach comes down to one line he likes to use: "I want to get you better yesterday."
At Gutierrez Chiropractic, the health of our patients comes first. We treat our patients the way we like to be treated, in a friendly, professional office where every patient matters. Nutritional, rehabilitation and ergonomic suggestions are also offered as part of a treatment plan when necessary.
Dr. G is a longtime Frisco resident. Outside the office he enjoys watching his kids at their sporting and cheer events, traveling, golfing, fishing, music and spending time around the Frisco community. Patients have rated the practice 4.9 from 86 Google reviews.

## Services
- Chiropractic care: Hands-on chiropractic care from Dr. G for injuries, aches and regular tune-ups.
- Foot Levelers foot scan inserts: We scan your feet for inserts that support the feet, ankles, knees, hips, spine and shoulders all at once.
- Massage therapy: A hands-on approach that targets specific muscles or muscle groups that need relaxation and stress relief.
- Electrical stimulation: Used to calm soft tissue that is inflamed, painful or in spasm.
- Inter-segmental traction: An open table that helps improve spinal motion with controlled, precise force.

## FAQ
Q: Are you a preferred provider for my plan?
A: We are a preferred in network provider for Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, United Health Care and several others. Give us a call to check your plan.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: You can call, email or text the office, whichever is easiest for you.

Q: Do you see patients from outside Frisco?
A: Yes. We serve Frisco, Little Elm, Plano and the surrounding areas.
